title: UK outline map with task list
subject: Geography
unit: Spring 2: Map skills and fieldwork (Tribal Tales)
source: Written for geography/y3 lesson 13 (UK outline map with task list (portal printable))
intro: Lesson 13: Human and physical features of the UK. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

blocks.title: Sort into: Physical / Human
blocks.task: sort them into the columns: Physical, Human.
blocks.answer: Physical: river; mountain; coast. Human: motorway; Stonehenge; farm

parts.text: Mark the dot and label it

keywords.def: a natural part of the land, like a river or hill
something people built, like a road
where the land meets the sea
one of the four parts of the UK
the most important city of a country

questions.q: Is a beach human or physical?
Is a hill fort human or physical?
questions.a: Human, built on a physical hill

questions.q: Core: On the UK map, mark Skara Brae, Stonehenge and Maiden Castle, the four capitals and three physical features (a river, a mountain and a coast).
questions.a: Correct places on the map sheet key

questions.q: Extend: Sort 10 feature cards into human and physical.
Stretch: Why might Stone Age people build near the coast?
questions.a: Food from the sea, travel by boat, shelter
B) A river. A river is natural; bridges and farms are made by people.

questions.q: Big question: mountain or motorway, what is the difference?
questions.a: A mountain is natural (physical); a motorway is built by people (human)
